text:
Amy: Heads-up — Sequoia wants to evaluate swapping from CompetitorX to Redwood. They asked for a PoC + answers to pricing and security asks. Can we sketch a plan? :eyes:
Rafael: 👍 I can lead the technical PoC. What do they care about most — API parity or cost/time to migrate?
Amy: Sales says parity is top, then SLA/SSO, then unit cost. They have an internal security questionnaire too.
Maria: Please send the questionnaire PDF. We need to check KMS, audit logs, and VPC options. If they want on-prem, that’s a different play.
Amy: Uploaded the secq here: https://rwd.internal/secq/sequoia-2026.pdf
John: For pricing — they expect billing to match CompetitorX's token model. We can propose a blended rate for first 90 days during PoC and then standard usage tiers. Need estimate of expected tokens/day from Sequoia.
Olivia: On infra: they request a dedicated env for the PoC with strict egress rules. We can spin a dedicated pool but need IPs and CIDR. How long for staging env?
Sam: I can provision a dedicated PoC cluster in sandbox region. ETA 48 hrs once we have CIDR + service account. Note: adapter shim for endpoint parity might need a quick proxy layer to normalize headers and rate limits.
Rafael: For prompt parity testing, can Sequoia provide a sample set of 500 prompts? We'll run blind A/B between CompetitorX and Redwood and produce delta reports. Also we should capture token counts and latency distributions.
Amy: They said yes to 500 prompts. Rafael, can we produce an eval harness and a short report template?
Rafael: Will do. Plan: 1) create shim proxy that accepts CompetitorX payloads, 2) run A/B across 500 prompts, 3) record outputs + token usage, 4) surface discrepancies in a short report. Example shim curl test I’ll give them:
```
curl -X POST https://poc-sequoia.redwood-internal/api/v1/complete \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-compat","prompt":"<their prompt>","max_tokens":256}'
```
Rafael: Also note model variants may behave differently; we'll include a fallback policy to an alternate quantized variant for cost SLOs.
Maria: Security note — they want to know about data retention policies and whether we persist prompts for >30 days. Provide exact retention and deletion process. Also flag: SOC2 + penetration test report required.
John: I'll draft the pricing addendum (90-day PoC tier + committed rate table). Need an estimate of peak QPS for the PoC to size reserved capacity.
Olivia: For SLA — they asked about per-request latency SLOs. We can commit to 95th percentile <200ms for small prompts on dedicated pool. Will caveat for long-context runs.
Amy: Two blockers from Sequoia legal: 1) they want data residency in EU for EU customers, 2) they want indemnity language around model hallucinations.
Maria: Data residency — for PoC we can route EU traffic to our eu-central region. For legal/indemnity we'll refer to enterprise counsel; might need standard carve-outs.
Sam: Operational checklist for PoC (short):
- receive CIDR + service account (from Sequoia)
- provision dedicated pool + shim proxy
- load eval harness and seed prompts
- exchange test API keys and shared test dataset
- smoke test and perf run
Olivia: I'll add monitoring dashboards and an alert runbook (who to page if latency spikes).
Amy: Timeline requested by Sequoia: kickoff Tues, 2-week PoC. Is that feasible?
Rafael: 2 weeks is tight but doable if infra is ready day 0 and they deliver prompts/test data. We should aim for a pre-kickoff checklist meeting tomorrow.
John: Pricing note — include a clause for overage billing if usage exceeds the PoC commitment to avoid surprises.
Maria: Also send them our SOC2 + pen test redacted report by EOD tomorrow if legal needs it. I can prepare redacted artifacts.
deploy-bot: [deploy] new sandbox cluster sequoia-poc created by sam_eng — 48h ETA for final IP allocations.
Amy: Great. Rafael, can you post the A/B harness repo link here when ready? Also I'll send Sequoia a consolidated next-steps mail after our pre-kickoff. :email:
Rafael: Will post repo link + minimal runbook (how to run A/B, sample script, expected output csv) by EOD.
Amy: Thanks everyone — let’s sync 11am PST tomorrow.
Rafael: See you.
Sam: 👍
